_meta.purpose: Qualitative result strings that the TF-IDF inputs keep as written (after lowercasing and punctuation cleanup) when no PCORnet category applies and the string cannot identify a lab code. Hand-edited.
_meta.inclusion_rule: A string is kept if it has no PCORnet category and either (a) appears under more than 5 distinct LOINC codes in MIMIC-IV, so it cannot identify a code, or (b) is numeric in form (matches one of the patterns below). Other strings without a category are dropped from the inputs, in training and testing alike. The MIMIC-IV counts behind (a) are not included.

nd not done wbc <=0 1.rationale: multi-LOINC non-result annotation; embedded numeric is part of the annotation

unable to report clotted.rationale: generic status with sample-clot reason, 19 LOINCs

unable to report specimen clotted.rationale: generic status with specimen-clot reason, 21 LOINCs

unable to report specimen qns.rationale: generic status with quantity-not-sufficient reason, 13 LOINCs

unable to report qns.rationale: generic status with QNS reason, 13 LOINCs

threshold.description: Numeric threshold at detection-limit: '<1', '>182', '<0 2', '>1 050'. Digit groups separated by space are the preprocessed form of decimal points.

range_int.description: Integer-integer range used for ordinal count bands: '0-2', '3-5', '6-10'.

text_threshold.description: English-prose threshold with optional single unit suffix: 'less than 10', 'greater than 20 ng/ml', 'less than 1 0'. Longer trailing text like 'verified by replicate analysis' is NOT matched — those strings are routed to paraphrase.

slash_fraction.description: Slash fractions (ventilation rate at LOINC 76526-3, Vent rate by CO2 meas) and their partial-fragment variants: '20/20', '16/0', '16/', '/20'. Source data at this LOINC records the two halves independently and sometimes truncates to one.
